items.title: Billy Taylor interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995
items.q: Monk Rowe also participated briefly in the interview.

ctx.x: Taylor is a prolific composer, his best known work, “I Wish I Knew How it Feels to be Free” has been recorded numerous times, both instrumentally and as a vocal piece.
Dr. Taylor was interviewed by Dr. Michael Woods in New York City on July 27, 1995. Monk Rowe also participated briefly in the interview.
We are filming a jazz archive series for Hamilton College, and we have with us here today one of the great men of jazz, Dr. Billy Taylor.
